services.name: Fishing Lessons
services.desc: We offer fishing lessons for individuals and families. Learn how to catch all the species in the Western Long Island Sound. Capt Joby Vinarski and Capt Andy LoCascio have over 60 combined years of knowledge they can share with you. We give lessons on our boats or your boat. We typically like to start with a lesson on one of our boats so that you can see exactly what we use and how we use it. We will help you select the best rod and reel outfits for your boat. We will teach who how to use them more effectively. blurb: Spend a morning, afternoon or evening, with some of the Northeast’s finest and most experienced Captains, including Capt. Andy LoCascio (Northeast Angling TV) and Capt. Joby Vinarski. Fish or just cruise the protected Western Long Island Sound waters from New York Harbor to Connecticut. Sharpen your skills and learn about the techniques, tactics and gear used to catch the big fish. No prior fishing or boating
